summary: Comprehensive frontend-only E2E testing of the Aviation Calculator Expo app at viewport 390x844. All four tabs (Fuel, Torque, Time, MEL), Settings modal, and persistence verified. All expected calculations match spec exactly. No React Native / Expo deprecated-package issues detected. No layout overflow at 390px. 100% of specified feature cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements have proper testID attributes.
Settings persisted via storage utility and reloaded on mount — verified working after full page reload.
No deprecated packages detected (uses expo-router, react-native-keyboard-controller, @react-native-vector-icons/feather, date-fns).
All text correctly wrapped in <Text>, styles via StyleSheet.create via makeStyles helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is offline, frontend-only. URL: https://flight-ops-calc.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844.
